༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor du slob ma smin par byed pa'i cho ga skal ldan shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta bcu pa phreng ldan ma la chig stong nyer bzhi mchis pa'i nang gsel ud+diṣ+ṭa brgya so bdun pa nas rnyed pa'i prāstā ras mdzes par byas pa'o// ༄༅// shrīlokeshwarān+yār+thānurāgamrak+tāṃshurnabaṃmeruprawāl/ s+yāsmāḥlās+yagarbāhar+ṣitit+yar+ṇabyastīranin+dod+begatsetā// ༄༅// dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug gzhan don la// rjes chags dmar 'od gsar par byi ru'i ri// nga yi 'jo sgeg snyems pa phrogs so zhes// chu gter 'gram du skyo bas bshung ba snyam// ma rtogs log brtag lha min spun gyi 'phrul// skyes sbyangs shes rab yangs pa'i gsus par bcil// rgyud don chu klung yongs btung legs bshad kyi// bdud rtsi 'bum skyugs bla ma a gas+t+ya// gang drin che ba'i cha shas gsob phyir du// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang lhag pa'i lha// bcu dgu'i thar pa'i grong khyer skal ba can// smin byed dbang gi cho ga rnam gsal bgyi// de la 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba rdzogs par thob cing bsnyen pa sogs kyis rgyud legs par sbyangs pa/ de kho na nyid bcu dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis rdo rje slob ma dag gis gsol ba 'debs pa'i ngor/ smin par byed pa'i cho ga brtsam pa la gsum ste/ sta gon gyi cho ga dang*/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga dang*/ mjug gi cho ga'o// dang po la'ang sbyor ba dang*/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ sta gon dngos te gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ gang du dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i gnas su rang ngam bla ma gong mas sa'i cho ga legs par byas pa'i sar rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na skya thig rdzogs par btab pa'i lha gnas dang*/ ras ris ltar na maṇ+ḍal dris byugs par lha'i bkod pa dang mthun pa'i lha grangs kyi tshom bu dang sa lha'i tshom bu zhig kyang bkod/

de'i mthar/ byang shar mtshams su mtshams 'dzin dang*// shar du bsang gtor mchod yon gnyis// shar lhor zhabs bsil lhor me tog /lho nub bdug spos nub mar me// nub byang dri mchog byang zhal zas// sgos mchod dang bcas zlum po dang*// ras bris la ni gru bzhir bsham// dbang ldan nas ni me mtshams bar// gtor ma gsum mam gnyis bsham mo// byang shar du ni sa lha yi// gtor ma sgos mchod bdug spos dang*// mar me zhal zas gsum yang bsham// logs su slob ma'i nyer spyod bzhi// so shing khyor chu dpung skud dang*// ku sha la sogs nyer mkho dang*// gzhan yang rdor dril nang mchod dang*// bum pa gnyis dang gzungs rdor dung*// gos zung sogs bsham sbyor ba'o// de nas gtor ma gcig nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs nas/ spro na mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba zhu/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ gis bsang*/ oṃ shu n+yā ta sogs kyis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas mgron rnams spyan drangs/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hūm̐ lan gsum gyis chu gsum dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis nyer spyod dang*/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rī hūm̐/ de bzhin du shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ par+ṣe badz+rī hūm̐ zhes rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ āḥsarba t+r+ya dh+wa dza zhes sogs gtor sngags gtor chog ltar lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ rdo rje snying gar bzung*/ dril bu sum brdung du dkrol te/

rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po che zhes sogs de nyid lnga pa dang*/ dril bu chig brdung du dkrol te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi// zhes pa nas/ zhi ba dang ni srung bar mdzad du gsol// hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ phyogs skyong ba khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar du gcod pa thams cad las srung ba dang*/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad las bsrung du gsol/ muḥzhes lag pa g.yas sa la reg ste/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams la/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba de dag sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ zhes brjod cing rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu gsil/ rol mo dang bcas te bgegs bskrad la gtor ma gtsang sar dor ro// gnas khang dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la dmigs te/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i nang du a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/

ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hūm̐ lan gsum gyis chu gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis nyer spyod rnams dang*/ rdo rje snying ga dang*/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs lan gsum gyis byin dbab bo// spro na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad rnams spyi dang mthun par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo la thim zhes pa'i bar gyi bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa sgrub thabs ltar nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa sta gon dngos la/ sa'i lha mo dang*/ lha dang*/ bum pa dang*/ slob ma sta gon te bzhi las/ dang po sa lha sta gon ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig 'bar ba hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ lag pa g.yas sa la bsnun te/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas dam bca' khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī re rer sbyar ba'i oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs rol chen dang*/ gtor ma chus sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/

spos rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyabs dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde// pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes su/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang zhes pa nas 'tshal na zhes pa'i bar gong sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs ltar brjod pa'i rjes su/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ des kyang rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsams la/ lag pa g.yas sa la reg ste/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī badz+ra muḥzhes pas sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par bsam zhing brjod/ de'i mchod gtor dman ma rnams bsdu'o// gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lha'i gnas ci lta ba bzhin du dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa dang mnyam du brjod pa'am/ bkod zin kyang rung ste/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūm̐ sogs nas oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛta hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar lha so so'i sngags lan gsum gsum bzla bar bya'o// de nas sa mchog ma byas na bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las aṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sogs nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi gdan zhes pa'i bar srung 'khor gzhal yas khang bcas sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ der lha rnams skad cig gis bskyed pa'am yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya ba gang rung bya bar sman zhabs kyis bshad pa ltar byas la/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po sogs nas bzhugs pa/

shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i sogs nas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po zhes sogs des rigs 'gros sbyar te byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi zhes pa nas oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad// mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa// rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin can// sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /ces brjod pa'i mthar/ rang gi g.yon du shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor zhes pa nas oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ zhes pas bstim pa'i bar dang*/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du mig gnyis kyi dbus su k+ṣiṃ las 'khor lo k+ṣiṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las sa snying dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhes pa nas/ sku rdo rje dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa zhes pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar ram/ yang na ming tsam brjod pas btub/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs pa la gtso bo'i sngags lan gsum gyis chu gsum dang rdo rje ma lngas sngar ltar mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse mo la gnas pa'i rig ma bum pa zhes pa nas/ dri rdo rje la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin brjod/

slar yang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bkug ste/ zhal du zhugs/ zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su gyur pa rdo rje nor bu'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+mar lhung ste zla ba'i gdan bcu la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkham̐ ram̐ lam̐ mām̐ pam̐ tām̐ rnams su gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bcur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ zhes pas de rnams rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ dpag tu med par gyur nas mdun bskyed kyi mtha' skor du 'khod de dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par bsam mo// de nas spos mar me rnams spar la/ mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon zhes pa nas rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsams la sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ lha yi bsang gtor dam pa 'dis// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal// thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te// mgon pos mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ hrīḥlo ke shwa ra oṃ āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas gtso bo yab yum dang*/ oṃ hrīḥ.ā ro lika oṃ āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas rigs bdag dang*/ de bzhin du oṃ bum̐ dzi na dzika oṃ ām̐ rat+na dhṛka oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka oṃ kham̐ pradzñā dhṛka oṃ lam̐ mo ha ra tī/ oṃ mam̐ dwe ṣa ra tī/ oṃ pam̐ rā ga ra tī/ oṃ tām̐ badz+ra ra tī/ oṃ dzaḥrū pa badz+rī/ oṃ hūm̐ shab+da badz+rī/ oṃ bam̐ gan+dhe badz+rī/ oṃ hoḥr sa badz+rī/ oṃ kham̐ spar+ṣe badz+rī/ oṃ ram̐ dharma dha tu badz+rī/ oṃ hūm̐ ya mān+ta kṛta/ oṃ hūm̐ pradzñān+ta kṛta/

oṃ hūm̐ pad+mān+ta kṛta/ oṃ hūm̐ bigh+nān+ta kṛta/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa re re bzhin sbyar bas 'khor gyi lha rnams la dbul lo// de bzhin du mchod yon dang*/ zhabs bsil gnyis kyang tshigs bcad kyi 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs sngags rnams 'dra'o// chu skyes de bzhin thang las skyes// me tog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes// oṃ hrīḥlo ke shwa ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas oṃ hūm̐ bigh+nān+ta kṛta puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā zhes pa'i bar brjod do// 'og ma rnams la'ang lha sngags de bzhin btags pas/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung*// de bzhin bdug spos mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni khyod kyis bzhes// dhū paṃ pra tīts+tshas bdug spos dang*/ zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di// lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms// mi shes thams cad zhi bya'i phyir// bdag nyid dad pas dbul bar bgyi// dī paṃ pra tīts+tshas mar me dang*/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes// gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tshas dri mchog dang*/ bza' dang bca' bar yang dag ldan// kha dog dri dang ro ldan zhing*// thams cad sbyar ba'i zhal zas 'di// 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// nai wi t+yes zhal zas dang*/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs// dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di// mchog tu dga' bas bdag 'bul gyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// shap+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā dang*/ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs brjod pas rol mo ci 'byor pa dbul lo// de nas gzugs sogs thabs kyi ngo bor byas pa'i mchod pa rgyud kyi dngos bstan/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas// mchod par byed pas mchod par bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi// zhes dang*/

lag pa g.yon rdo rje khu tshur du byas pa'i mdzub mo'i tshigs bar par/ g.yas thal mo brkyang ba'i mkhrig ma gyen du blangs te bzhag pa me long gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas// lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gtso// rol mo dbul zhing gong 'og gi sngags rnams thams cad la sbyar la/ shab+da kā ma gu ṇa/ dri la rnam gsum shes byas te// sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// 'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso// g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis dung chos 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas mtheb mdzub sbyar nas/ sor mo lhag ma gsum brkyangs pa'i rtses dri chu blangs te lha rnams la byugs pa'i tshul du byas la/ gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa/ ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas// lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ ra sa kā ma gu ṇa/ reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas// bdag gi rigs la dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can// mi bskyod pa yi tshul brnyes pa'o// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis stod g.yogs smad g.yogs 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa/ de ltar gzugs sogs yul lnga po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngar bsgoms la des dkyil 'khor mchod par bsam mo// gzugs sogs shes rab kyi ngo bor byas pa'i mchod pa ni/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// 'jo sgeg sgyu 'phrul rol pas mtha' yas zhing bkang nas// ma lus rgyal ba dpe med gzugs kyi sprin gyis mchod// kun 'dzin rnam sbyong ma chags rab dga'i sar sgrub shog /oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rī hūm̐/

bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// yan lag 'khril ldan dbyangs kyis mtha' yas zhing bkang nas// ma lus rgyal ba dpe med dbyangs kyi sprin gyis mchod// 'chal tshul rnam sbyong khrims dag dri med sar sgrub shog /oṃ āḥshab+da badz+rī hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// dri zhim spos ngad ldan pas mtha' yas zhing bkang nas// ma lus rgyal ba dpe med dri med sprin gyis mchod// khro ba rnam sbyong bzod dag 'od byed sar sgrub shog /oṃ āḥgan+dhe badz+rī hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// ro mchog brgya ldan mtha' yas bcud kyis zhing bkang nas// ma lus rgyal ba dpe med ro mchog sprin gyis mchod// le lo rnam sbyong brtson dag 'od 'phro'i sar sgrub shog /oṃ āḥr sa badz+rī hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// 'jam zhing bde bskyed reg byas mtha' yas zhing bkang nas// ma lus rgyal ba dpe med reg mchog sprin gyis mchod// g.yeng ba rnam sbyong rtse gcig sbyang dka'i sar sgrub shog /oṃ āḥspar+ṣe badz+rī hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// spros med rgya chen chos kyis mtha' yas zhing bkang nas// ma lus rgyal ba dpe med chos kyi sprin gyis mchod// mi shes rnam sbyong shes rab mngon gyur sar sgrub shog /oṃ āḥdharma dhā tu badz+rī hūm̐ zhes pas mchod/ de nas rgyas par spro na thun mong gi mchod pa dang*/ khyad par gyi mchod pa dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi mchod pa rnams ni mchod sprin rgya mtsho bzhin bya'o// nang gi mchod pa ni/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod spyi bo nas gtor te/ oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang bkra shis bzang po pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

dpral ba'i thad nas gtor te/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo a ti sha lha btsun byang chub 'od/ 'am pa byang chub rdo rje/ rgya lcags ri gong pa/ rdzing bu kha pa shākya grags/ spen phug dar ma grags/ zhang ye pa/ gze pa don grub/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ sras chos grags/ dar ma shākya/ bsod nams dbang po/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gnyen chen grags pa blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ de dbon nam mkha' rin chen/ hor nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas btsun kun dga' chos 'phel/ chos rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la sogs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag mnos/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du= snying ga'i thad du gtor te/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika ces pa nas/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ zhes dbul/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du= srin lag gis bdud rtsi blangs nas lce rtse smin mtshams spyi gtsug gsum du thig le byas pas lus kyi lha rnams tshim par bsam zhing oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ skabs 'dir gtor ma la bar phud bran no// lte ba'i thad nas gtor te/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī dharma pā la tsa turmu kha oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du= phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ 'jig byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ gza' dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams kyi zhal du= gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi= bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal= 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can rnams tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// rgyas par spro na nang gi mchod pa lnga char yang mchod sprin rgya mtsho bzhin bya'o// gsang ba'i mchod pa ni rang gi snying ga nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dpag tu med pa spros nas mdun gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phul bas rgyal ba rnams rig ma'i 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod cing mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar bsams la/ mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma thugs rje'i spyan// brtan mdzad dbyings kyis 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun// zhi mdzad thabs mkhas ring song sa sgrub ma// 'jig rten dbang phyug lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma byams pa'i bdag /rlan mdzad dbyings kyis 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun// bsrung mdzad smon lam mi g.yo'i sa sgrub ma// 'jig rten dbang phyug lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma dga' dkar mo// smin mdzad dbyings kyis 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun// rgyas mdzad mi rdzi legs pa'i sa sgrub ma// 'jig rten dbang phyug lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma btang snyoms sgom// g.yon mdzad dbyings kyis 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun// dbang mdzad ye shes chos sprin sa sgrub ma// 'jig rten dbang phyug lha tshogs=

mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma ye shes dbyings// go 'byed dbyings kyis 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun// mchog mdzad chos sku kun du 'od sgrub ma// 'jig rten dbang phyug lha tshogs mnyes= /re re'i mjug tu oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ zhes brjod pas mchod do// bzhi pa yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid/ pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya a warta ya hoḥzhes brjod pas mchod pa dpag tu med pa yid kyis sprul nas mchod par bsams te/ gser las grub cing rtsibs stong mu khyud ldan// dgra las rgyal byed 'khor lo rin chen gyis// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyis mthas gtugs pa// bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dzi te aḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du tshig rkang pa tha ma gnyis dang*/ sngags kyi 'go thams cad la 'dra bar sbyar la/ dpag tshad du mar snang ba'i 'od 'gyed cing*// 'dod dgu'i re skong nor bu rin chen gyis// ma ṇi rat+na= phrag dog skyon bral bde ba'i dpal bskyed cing*// gzugs mdzes blta sdug bud med rin chen gyis// s+t+rī rat+na= chos min spangs shing 'gro la phan pa sgrub// mkhas gsal yid gzhungs skyes bu rin chen gyis// na ra rat+na= thal dkar glang chen stobs kyi shugs kyis 'gro// yan lag bdun ldan glang po rin chen gyis// ga dza rat+na= 'dod pa'i gnas su skad cig tsam la bgrod// cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang rta mchog gis// a shwa rat+na= gang gis bcangs pas bdud dang mu stegs sogs// phas rgol tshar gcod ral gri rin chen gyis// khaḍ+ga rat+na= zhes rgyal srid sna bdun dbul lo// de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po sogs de nyid lnga pa dang*/ sems can kun don bsgrub par dam bcas smon lam shing rtar brten// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i stobs las rab skyes sgyu 'phrul gzugs// pad+ma rā ga'i lhun por 'od stong gis 'khyud 'gran min pa// thugs rje'i spyan ras 'gro la gzigs pa'i dbang phyug de la 'dud// gang gi dngos kun gdod nas gsal bas mkha' bzhin zhi zhing dag

/yang dag gsal bas bsres pa'i 'khor los kun 'das rab bzlog pa'i// rtag sogs rgyal ba bskyed byed 'gro kun de nyid gcig pa po// khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' de la phyag 'tshal lo// de yi gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed rnam par shes pa rnams// 'khrul dang bral bas dri med phung po dngos por grub pa ste// 'dod chags la sogs thabs kyis de bskyod mngon par byang chub phyir// sems don bdag bcas rnam rig las skyes rtag sogs de la 'dud// sa chu me rlung rang bzhin gyur cing tshangs spyod bzhi las skyes// 'jo sgeg rol gdung rab tu brod pa'i yid dga' gang gi sems// sgyu ma'i sku yis rang 'byor mtha' ru de sgrol rab mkhas pa// rdo rje theg par 'gro ba'i lam mchog spyan ma la sogs de la 'dud// de bzhin mig la sogs pa'i gti mug dam tshig las byung zhing*// ma ning gnas su rgyas btab de las thams cad mkhyen pa skye// rig pa'i rgyal po lha yi mig sogs gang bar gsol mdzad pa// sa snying la sogs sems dpa' tshogs chen de la rab tu 'dud// gzugs la sogs pa'i spyod yul 'dul bar dka' ba nyams byas pa// bla na med pa'i 'dod pa rnams kyis rnal 'byor gang gi sems// tshim par mdzad pa 'di la sgrub bya mchog 'byung gang yin pa'i// gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs lha mo'i tshogs chen de la 'dud// kun du sbyor ba'i gdeng g.yos rab brgyan drag po'i cha lugs 'chang*// 'jigs byed zhal bzhad sa 'dzin g.yo zhing thub skrag sdig las so// dad pa la sogs sems su gtogs dang de yi rang bzhin chos// dam par gzugs sogs rnam dag gshin rje'i gshed sogs de la 'dud// zhes sh+lau ka gcig kho bos dang phyi ma drug tsi lu pas mdzad pa 'di dag gis kyang bstod par bya'o// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis/ kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa'i nang rdzas so lnga blugs te/

dung chos dri bzang gi chus bkang ba'i steng rdo rje la gzungs thag btags pa legs par bshams la/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i gnas su rab tu rgyas pa'i pad+ma rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi gdan dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku thams cad dang rtsa zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rang dang 'dra ba'i yum 'jig rten dbang phyug ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas pad+ma/ gsum pas ral gri sogs nas krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas sogs nas kyis bzhugs pa'o// mer spyan ma dkar mo sogs nas shar gyi byang du reg rdo rje ma sogs dang*/ shar gyi lhor chos dbyings rdo rje ma sogs nas bzhugs pa'o// shar du gshin rje'i gshed sogs nas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ las thams cad pa'i bum par bdud rtsi 'khyil pa nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ khro bo lnga po thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang gis zhes pa nas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o// rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug lha bcu dgu bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta dzaḥspro na/

ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin sogs kyis spyan drangs pa la/ chu gsum rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥpradzñān+ta kṛta sogs nas/ dri rdo rje la rin chen 'byung ldan dang zhes pa'i bar lha sta gon bzhin las bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ de nas oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra re re sngon du 'gro ba'i gtso bo'i sngags lan gsum gyis chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo dang*/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rī sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥhrīḥbum̐ ām̐ dz+rī kham̐/ lam̐ mām̐ pam̐ tām̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkham̐ ram̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ gis nang mchod phul te/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ pad skor dang bcas pas gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la zhon te song bas lha rnams kyi rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me sogs nas lha bcu dgu'i sngags dang*/ las bum la oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ zhes bzlas so// slar yang gong ltar chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo rdo rje ma lnga nang mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dngos grub blang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ dung chos kyi chu bum pa gnyis su oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes phul bas lha rnams 'dod du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur bsams la/ so so'i ku shas gtor te/ rnam rgyal la bdag gi slob ma thams cad la dbang bskur ba mdzod cig ces dang*/ las bum la bdag gi slob ma thams cad kyi bgegs bzlog tu gsol/ zhes snyan gsan dbab bo// spos rdor dril 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug

/rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis// dkyil 'khor bdag nyid 'dri bar 'tshal// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la// de ni gnang ba mdzad par rigs// sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol// byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*// gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*// gang su lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i// sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dkyil 'khor spyan ras gzigs 'byung ba// 'gro ba dag par bya ba'i phyir// yo byad ci 'byor pas 'dri na// deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la// thugs ni brtse bas dgongs nas su// tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig ces brjod do// gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis bran nas/ sgrub thabs kyi bdud rtsi ltar byin rlabs dus gcig la byas la/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de las byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur zhes bsam zhing brjod la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ āḥhrīḥbh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ kham̐ lam̐ mām̐ pam̐ tām̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkham̐ ram̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ zhes gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ chu gsum la gtso bo'i sngags dang nyer spyod kyis mchod la/ sngar gyi sngags kyis bdud rtsir gtor/ de nyid lnga pas bstod nas/ rdo rje gsum dngos mi phyed sku// ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che// 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/

de nas chos skyong gi gtor ma rnams rim pa bzhin du bsngos nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ rang skad cig gis 'jig rten dbang phyug gsal ba'i thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten skyong ba rnams bkug ste/ rang rang gi gzugs kyis rang rang gi phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod par bsams la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje phur bu bcu stod rang rang gi phyogs kyi srung 'khor gyi khro bo'i dbyibs su gnas pa/ lte ba man chad rdo rje rtse gcig pa lta bus shes rab ma la 'khyud pa spros nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i khro bo spros te/ g.yon pas phur bu'i mgul pa nas bzung*/ g.yas pas rdo rje tho bas spyi bo nas brdungs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta/

gshin rje'i gshed/ sarba duṣ+ṭa dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang ba thams cad phur bus thob cig in+d+rā na sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥpradzñān+ta kṛta/ shes rab mthar byed/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ya de bzhin du gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang ba thams cad/ mān sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥpad+mān+ta kṛta/ pad+ma mthar byed/ sarba duṣ+ṭa klu 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang ba thams cad/ nā gā na sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta/ bgegs mthar byed/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ga tshogs bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang ba thams cad/ na pa tī na sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ ṭak+ki rā dzaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭa ag+nī me lha 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang ba thams cad/ na sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥnī dbyug sngon can/ la daṇ+ḍa/ sarba duṣ+ṭa bden bral 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang ba thams cad/ ne ṛr t+yān sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥm stobs po che/ hā bā la/ sarba duṣ+ṭa wā yūn/ sa pa rlung lha 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang ba thams cad/ ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ.a tsa mi g.yo ba/ la/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ī dbang ldan 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang ba thams cad/ sha nā na sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥtsakra 'khor los sgyur ba/ warti/ sarba duṣ+ṭa tsan+d+ra zla ba nyi ma tshangs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang ba thams cad/ arka pi tā ma hā na sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ gnod mdzes rgyal po/ sum+bha rā dzā/ sarba thags bzangs ris dang sa'i lha 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang ba thams cad phur bus thob cig duṣ+ka bi ma tsi tra pṛ thi wī de wān sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing rkang pa'i bar mthar thug pa'i bar du phur bus btab pas thams cad kyang gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur gyur pa ni/

shar du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma thogs pa/ de'i g.yon phyogs su rdo rje sgyu ma sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na dung dang pad+ma/ shar lhor rdo rje me dmar po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na bgrang phreng dang mi 'jigs pa ster ba/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang gun+dhe/ lhor rdo rje dus nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang rin po che/ lho nub tu rdo rje gtun shing nag po cod paṇa 'dra/ g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ nub tu rdo rje klu dkar po 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na sbrul zhags dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang rin po che/ nub byang du rdo rje rlung ljang gu don grub kyis cod paṇa can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na gos dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang rin po che/ de'i g.yon phyogs na rdo rje sna rings dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na dung dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang chang gis bkang ba'i kham phor/ byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na bī dza pū ra dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang ne'u le thogs pa/ byang shar du rdo rje khro bo dkar po 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/

dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na rtse gsum dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma/ steng gi phyogs kyi cha la rdo rje 'od dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na pad+ma dkar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang 'khor lo/ de'i g.yas su rdo rje 'khyil pa nag po rin 'byung gi cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis snga ma dang 'dra/ g.yon du rdo rje mi smra ser po rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na pad+ma ser po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis sngar dang 'dra/ 'og tu thags bzangs ris sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma/ de'i g.yon du sa'i lha mo ser mo rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na pad+ma ser po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang 'khor lo thogs pa/ thams cad kyang sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ rin po che'i cod paṇa can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lha'i gos dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang ldan pa mtshan dang dpe byad nye bar 'bar ba gsal gdab bo// bsdus par 'dod na rang rang gi phyogs su rang rang gi ming dang kha dog tsam brjod nas 'di dag thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng na zhes sogs kyis gsal bas yang rung ngo*// de nas rdo rje ma lnga dang*/ nyer spyod kyis mchod nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ āḥsarba sngags 'di dag gi bod skad ni 'og gi dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi// zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad ltar yin no//

t+ya dh+wa dzā da sha dika lo ka dhā tu a nan+ta ga ga na/ sa mu dra ma ga ta byū ha pra sa ra/ pa ra ma nu dza maṇ+ḍa la/ pa ram+pa ra an+targa ta/ sa mā pat+ti a bas+thi tā/ dharma dhā tu sam ba sa rā ṇā/ ā kā sha dhā tu par+ya bas+sā naḥ sarba t+r+ya dh+wa dzā dā sha dika lo ka dhā tu a nan+ta me gha byū ha/ pra sa ra ga ga na sa māḥ sarba lo ka pā la sarba satwā sh+tsa/ tad+ya thā/ badz+rā yu dha/ mā yā badz+ra/ badz+rā na la/ badz+ra kā la/ badz+ra mu sa la/ nā ga badz+ra/ badz+rā ni la/ badz+ra shauṇ+ḍa/ badz+ra bhai ra wa/ badz+ra kro dha/ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li/ badz+ra pra bhā/ mu na badz+ra/ bi ma tsi tra/ pṛ th+wī de wa tā sa pa ri wā ra/ i maṃ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ a di sang yuk+taṃ/ ba liṃ u pa he raṃ pra tīts+tsha u pa bhu dz+ya/ ma ma sarba satwāts+tsha hi ra ṇ+ya su war+ṇa/ dha na dhā n+ya ā yur yau wa na/ a ro gya sat+su khaṃ/ a ba ha ra kān sarba bigh+nāṃ bi nā ya kā na/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ pra duṣ+ṭāṃ/ ma nu ṣ+ya a ma nu ṣ+yā na/ dzam+bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ ban+dha ya/ bidh+wan+sā ya/ ma ma hi ra ṇ+ya su war+ṇa dha nadhā n+ya ā yur yau wa ṇa/ a ro gya sat+su kha naṃ ma hā su kha pra bṛd+dha ye/ ya wata ā bo dhi maṇ+ḍa par+ya bas+sa yan+ti/ ḍhau ka ya ti si dā sa ha yi ka shīn+taṃ rak+ṣañtsa ku ru hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod gtor nas thams cad kyang rigs lnga'i ngo bor mos par bya ste/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po che// zhes sogs de nyid lnga pa dang*/ oṃ āḥdus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi// 'jig rten khams rnams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa// rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bkod pa rab 'byams kyi// shin tu phra ba'i rdul skyes dkyil 'khor ni// phan tshun gcig gi nang du gcig son pa// snyoms par 'jug la kun du gnas pa yi// chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par 'du zhing*// nam mkha'i khams kyi yongs su mthar thug pa'i// dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi// 'jig rten khams rnams mtha' yas sprin bkod pa// nam mkha' rab 'byams mnyam dang 'jig rten skyong*// kun dang sems can kun yang 'di lta ste// rdo rje mtshon cha sgyu ma rdo rje dang*// rdo rje me dang rdo rje dus dang ni// rdo rje gtun shing rdo rje klu dag dang*// rdo rje rlung dang rdo rje sna rings dang*// rdo rje 'jigs byed rdo rje khro bo dang*// rdo rje 'khyil pa rdo rje 'od dang ni// mi smra rdo rje dang ni thags bzangs ris// sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la// me tog dag dang bdug pa mar me dang*// dri dang lha bshos la sogs yang dag ldan// nye bar spyod pa dang ni gtor ma 'di// so sor bzhes shig nye bar longs spyod nas// bdag gi dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho tshe// nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa rnams// 'phrog par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren kun// sdang dang rab tu sdang ba thams cad dang*// mi dang mi ma yin rnams rmugs par mdzod// rangs dang bcings dang rnam par 'jig par mdzod// bdag la dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho tshe// nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa dang*// bde ba chen po rab tu 'phel ba rnams// ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar thug pa// gnang bar mdzad cing rtag tu stong grogs dang*// zhi ba dang ni bsrung bar mdzad du gsol// hūm̐ zhes pas dngos grub ster ba nyid du gsol ba btab bo// bzhi pa slob ma sta gon la/

mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma nyer lnga tshun kha yar ba rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa dang sems bskyed gsal gdab par bskul te/ de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam par mthun par chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa gsungs pa de dag phyogs ris su bsdu na/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ 'dir sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la'ang rgyud sde'i dbye bsdu mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung ba las/ 'dir ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de lngar 'dod pa las 'dir phyi ma yin/ de la thabs kyi rgyud/ shes rab kyi rgyud/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud gsum las/ 'dir thabs rgyud yin/ de la zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ gdul bya 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i ched du gtso bor gsungs pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor dang*/ gdul bya zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i ched du gtso bor gsungs pa dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi skor dang*/ gdul bya gti mug can 'dul ba'i ched du gtso bor gsungs pa rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skor te pha rgyud sde gsum las/ 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ste/ de la'ang lugs srol gsum gyi nang nas 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang*/ rgyud phyi ma dang*/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud rnams kyi dgongs pa/ 'jam dpal sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi zhal lung dri ma med pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyis legs par bkral ba'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/

dang po sta gon gyi skabs su bab pa yin/ de la sa'i lha mo sta gon dang*/ lha sta gon dang*/ bum pa sta gon dang*/ slob ma sta gon te bzhi las/ dang po gsum kho bos grub zin nas/ phyi ma khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma sta gon la/ lus kyi bya ba nges 'byung bskyed// nang dbang bskur la khyad don zhu// spro ba bskyed de rgyun bshags bya// bsrung ba byas te mchod pas mchod// so shing dor dang khyor chu blud// srung skud btags te ku sha sbyin// zab mo'i chos bshad rmi lam brtag /slob dpon gsol btab sdom pa gzung*// zhes pa ltar chos tshan bco lnga yod pa rim pa ltar lus kyi bya ba khrus byas phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas/ rang rang gi gral la snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas gus pa'i sgo nas 'khod du gzhug ces 'byung bas/ slob dpon la 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed du gzhug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga las/ 'khor bzhi char yang rjes su gnang*// rang gi bslab dang shin tu ldan// theg chen la dga'i bdag nyid can// la la gsang sngags grub don gnyer// 'di ni dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer// 'jig rten pha rol gnyer ba yis// dad pa mang du byed pa yi// blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi// tshe 'di'i 'dod par gyur pa la// 'jig rten pha rol don med 'byung*// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer gyis// 'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas// zhes gsungs te/ sngags kyi dngos grub sogs nas 'dra ba lags/ zhes pa'i bar kye rdor dbang bshad ltar brjod de 'og ma rnams su'ang shes par bya'o// nang dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

slob dpon 'jig rten dbang phyug yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de nyid slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lha mo'i pad+mar babs pas khyed rang skad cig gis 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku can re rer gyur par mos/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lha mo'i bha gar babs pas/ khyed rnams 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku can du gsal ba'i spyi bo nas thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag par byas te/ dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan cig tu byung*/ slar yang yum gyi bha ga nas phyir phyung ste rang rang gi gral la 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byas pas sogs gzhan ltar brjod/ khyad par can gyi don zhu ba ni/ slob dpon 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i zhes sogs nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// zhes pas gsol ba btab ste/ de'i don ni slob dpon la dga' chen zhes sogs nas gzhug tu gsol zhes pa'i don to// khyad par can gyi lam rdo rje theg pa la don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa de shin tu legs pa yin no zhes spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/

khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams// 'gro la phan par bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga mchog bzang 'di brnyes nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// mthu dang mnyam med ye shes des// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ khyed rnams cho ga'i sgo nas sogs brjod/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i skyabs su 'gro ba sogs nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sogs nas/ rjes su yi rang snyam pa dang*/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog cig snyam pa yongs su bsngo ba dang*/ yul thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ bdag nyid kyi dngos po dbul bar bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'jug pa ste/ don de rnams yid la dran bzhin pa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

gang zhig thog med sogs brjod/ ces pa'i rgyun bshags lan gsum sogs nas nyams na sor chud par byed pa yin/ bsrung ba bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs spros te/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos/ slob dpon gyis las bum gyi chus slob ma la gtor zhing oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ zhes pas bar chad bsrungs te/ slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas khyed rang rnams 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku can du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du mas rim gyis reg ste/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/ mgrin par pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ spyi bor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po rnams lam gyis byung bar mos pa mdzod/ slob ma re re la hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ de ltar byas pas khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gdod ma nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pa de cho ga 'dis ngo 'phrod cing gsal bar 'gyur ba yin/ de ltar khyed rnams byang chub tu sems bskyed cing*/ sgo gsum lhar byas ma thag pa de mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas me tog spyi bor phul te mchod par mos/ oṃ puṣ+pe sogs nas gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ zhes pas mchod pa ni lus ngag yid gsum lhar shes pas 'dod yon lam chags par longs spyod cig ces pa'i don yin/ de ltar lhar bskyed cing mchod nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa la so shing la brten nas brtag pa ni/ a shwata u dum+bā ra yi// so shing sor ni bcu gnyis pa// ma yo ma gas srog chags med// rtse mor me tog bcas pa sbyin// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ so shing bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing bskyed nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra saṃ war+dha ni ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes pas byin/ de ltar byin pa'i so shing de rgyu rin po che zhes pa nas dor ba sogs 'dra'o// de ni rnal 'byor chen po'i bum dbang sogs brjod/ rmi lam gsal por 'byung ba dang ngag gi dri ma sbyong byed khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ dri zhim po'i chu la/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥ

chos rnams thams cad rnam dag pas// sdig pa thams cad nges par sbyongs// rnam par rtog pa thams cad byabs/ sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ nish+tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas lan gsum byin/ de ni gsang dbang gi snod rung byed pa'i thabs yin sogs brjod/ rmi lam la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir srung skud 'dogs pa ni/ srad bu la hūm̐ bzlas nas mdud pa gsum gyis btab par gtso bo'i sngags sogs nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta dngos gzhi gnyis pa man chad la mdun bskyed lha rnams zhes bsgyur/ gon gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te dam tshig pa'i srad bu la thim zhes dang*/ las sngags bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yas dang*/ bud med kyi g.yon par nyis skor du bcings/ bum chus gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ zhes bzlas pas brtan par bya'o// de ni shes rab ye shes kyi sogs brjod/ rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang mal stan lhag par gnas pa'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhī dang ha las bskyed cing dhīḥdang has sbyin/ de'ang sngon byung bcom ldan 'das sogs brjod/ chos zab mo bshad pas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum+bā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal ba bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur lags na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba// de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rang byung skal ba chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes pa ste de'i don ni 'jig rten na u dum+bā ra'i sogs nas dga' ba khyad par can dang ldan par gyis shig ces pa'i tha tshig go

/rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag ces sogs nas rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos pa yin zhes pa'i bar rnams 'dra'o// sang nyin rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur bar zhu ba la do nub nas maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab dgos pas/ slar yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba// stsal nas mgon pos bdag la ni// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom dang gsang ba dam pa ni// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsungs// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ mdor na rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// dus 'di nas ni sogs rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ba brjod cing gzung ngo*// de rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi cho ga rnams legs par grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sang nyin 'byung ba lags zhes brjod cing slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*// sta gon gyi rjes kyi cho ga la/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos te/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon zhes pa nas rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsams la so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtso bo'i sngags lan gsum gyis chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/

oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ri sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ nang mchod/ oṃ āḥhrīḥbum̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ kham̐/ lam̐ mām̐ pam̐ tām̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkham̐ ram̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ gis nang mchod phul te/ rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po zhes sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes dngos grub blangs nas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol ba'i mthar khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs te rtse sprad pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs nam mkhar bteg par bsam zhing ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra ut+tiṣ+ṭha/ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te/ sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes brjod/ de la slar yang chu gsum nyer spyod kyi mchod pa/ rdo rje lnga'i mchod pa/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa/ bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad ces sogs kyis dngos grub blang*/ chos skyong gi bris sku la sogs pa gtor mgrin gyi rten yod pa rnams la thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ sku gzugs kyi rten med na mi dgos so// rten med pa'i gtor mgron rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro nas hūm̐ muḥzhes pa'i bar dang mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas te/ rten la ma brtan pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim zhes brjod/ rang gi mig tu sa snying dkar po zhes pa nas spyi bor sku rdo rje dkar po zhes pa'i bar gyis skye mched dang thugs gsung sku'i lha rnams gsal gdab/ rdo rje 'chang ba chen po'i dpal// zhes sogs sam/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas zhes sogs gang mos kyis/ bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba'i smon lam byas la/ sta gon gyi mchod pa dman ma rnams bsal lo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la bzhi ste/ bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ de'i nub mo dge ba'i bya ba la brtson zhing nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal nas sang nang par lha sta gon gyi tshom bu dang mchod pa dman pa rnams bsal la/ tshon rtsi kha dog lnga la/ dz+rīṃ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ hūm̐ kham̐ rnams bris pa dmar po dbus dang*/ sngon po nub la sogs pa'i phyogs su bkod nas srad bu kha dog lnga yang so sor gzhag mdun du mchod pa rnam lnga dang gtor ma bshams te/ bsang sbyangs/ thig tshon rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rab tu rgyas pa'i pad+ma rnams kyi steng*/ dbus dang phyogs gzhan gsum du nyi ma dang shar du zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ dbus su thig tshon dmar po dz+rīṃ las 'od dpag med dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/

g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar du thig tshon dkar po bh+rūm̐ las rnam snang dkar po sogs dang*/ lhor thig tshon ser po ām̐ las rin 'byung ser po sogs dang*/ nub tu thig tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po sogs dang*/ byang du thig tshon ljang gu khaṃ las don grub ljang gu sogs nas 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang mdzes pa'i ral pa'i sogs nas bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyis bskyed/ rang gi mig gnyis su dza las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od 'bar bar bskyed de/ mig gi rdzi ma myur du brdabs pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha dang 'od dpag med la sogs pa rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par spyan drangs nas thig tshon so so la thim par bsams shing*/ rnam snang la sogs thugs ye shes// srad bu thams cad byed dang bcas// rang gi 'khor lo thig gdab phyir// rtag pa'i thig ni stsal du gsol// zhes pa nas/ pad+ma gar dbang thig stsol cig /ces pa'i bar 'don pa bsgyur nas gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐ gis bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ a kā ro'i sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas rigs lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur par bsam mo// de nas thig rnams rang gi lag pa g.yon du bzung la g.yas pas slob ma la rim pa bzhin gtad de/ oṃ āḥ.a n+yo3n+ya a phan tshun rjes su son pa ste/ nu ga tāḥ/ sarba dharmāḥpa chos kun phan tshun rjes su 'jug ra pa ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭāḥ/ sarba dharmaḥbadz+ra chos kun rdo rje thal mo sbyar/ añdza li a t+yan+ta/ a nu pra biṣ+ṭāḥ chos kun shin tu rjes su zhugs/ sarba dharma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dri bzang gi chus sbags nas rdo rje'i lte bar dkris te bsrung ba byas la gzhag go

/de nas tshon rnams/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tsi kra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing mtheb srin gyis mnyes la gzhag go /de nas slob dpon gyis g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis thig skud lte bar bzung nas las kyi rdo rje la dza dzaḥgasum bzlas nas gtad/ des kyang dza dzaḥgasum bzlas nas blangs te/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs// khyed kyis 'gro don mdzad dus lags// thig skud sgra yis bskul nas ni// de rnams 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ mtheb srin g.yas pas thig skud 'og nas bskor zhing steng du thig gdab/ de nas sa la yang gdab/ de'i rim pa yang slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du gnas pas tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du lho dang byang na gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa/ me dang dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi logs thig rlung dang srin por gnas pas nub kyi logs thig slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang gi logs thig me dang srin por gnas pas lho'i logs thig slob dpon de nyid slob ma rlung du gnas pas mtshams thig dang po/ srin po dang dbang ldan du gnas pas mtshams thig gnyis pa/ gdab lugs 'di la dbus nas lcags ri g.yas skor du bskor ba yang bshad do// de nas slob dpon gyis nub phyogs nas ye thig bteg nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs te/ hī brjod pas sgo dbye bar bsam mo// de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug nas dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser sngo ljang dmar ba sgo tshad gcig 'dri ste/ de'i tshe oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ye hūm̐/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can rnams ni grol byed pa// 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po bdag /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba// 'khor lo'i nang na yang dag gnas// zhes brjod de de'i steng du thod pas bkab ste rdo rje bzhag nas bsrungs te mchod do// de nas gzhan gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas brtsams te rim pa bzhin 'dri ste/

sngar las thig gi skabs su dkyil 'khor rta babs dpangs su sgo tshad gcig ma/ phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba dang 'od zer phreng bas bskor ba spyi dang mthun par gdab/ nang du lha snam rim pa gcig bzhag nas dbus cha chen drug pa la 'od zer phreng bas zlum por bskor nas tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon cha phran gsum gsum dor nas bzhi pa la thig tal por btab pas le dgur 'gyur ro// lha snam ni shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub sngo/ byang ljang*/ lte ba dmar ba/ gdan sgrub thabs ltar/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i steng du dbus su pad+ma dmar po/ shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu rdo rje/ byang du ral gri ljang gu sogs lha so so'i phyag mtshan bri ba'am/ mi nus na sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon phung bya'o// gzhan gzhal yas khang gi khyad par rnams ni spyi dang mthun no// gdan bris nas mtshan ma bkod pa'i bar der/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra ṇāṃ/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya ma hā daṃ ṣ+ṭ+rot+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la/ pā ra shu pā sha hastā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nā na bi nā yā kā nāṃ/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dzīṃ wi ta an+ta ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing*/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi nga rgyal gyis bgegs bskrad par bshad do// de ltar bris zin nas ye thig dang dkyil 'khor bteg pa rdul tshon gyis bris pa la bstim/ thig skud dang tshon lhag ma mchod pa lngas mchod la ye shes pa sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor la spos rol mo dang bcas pas bum pa rnams spyan drangs te/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas pa'i mthar lha so so'i sngags brjod cing*/ de dang de'i gnas su 'bul tshul tsam byas la/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes brjod de rnam rgyar shar dang*/

las bum bgegs mthar byed la 'bul tshul dang dkyil 'khor gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung du gsol zhes brjod de dbang ldan du gzhag go /ras bris kyi phyogs yin na/ thig tshon byin rlabs nas 'di'i bar dor la/ ras bris rab gnas can gzhi bzang po'i steng du zhal shar du phyogs par dgram/ dkyil 'khor mthar chu gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang sgos mchod ci 'byor pa ras bris ltar na gru bzhi dang rdul tshon ltar na zlum por bsham/ byang shar nas shar lho'i bar 'das gtor nas rim bzhin bsham mo// gzhan yang sngon 'gro gtor ma/ phyi rol gyi chas/ slob ma dbang bskur la dgos pa'i dbang rdzas nyer mkho rnams kyang tshang bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ nangs par sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi rjes su/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭān phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha rod ādzñā pa ya ti/ kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs bsal nas/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe pū dza sogs nyer spyod dang rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hoḥ rang nyid dkyil 'khor dbus kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i snying gar a dkar po las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥ'i yi ge pad+ma rā ga'i mdog lta bu zhes pa nas lha mo bcur gyur pa rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros te bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor mchod ces pa yan chad sgrub thabs ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi tshul gyis bsgom pa bzlas pa'i bar bya ba ste/ de'i khyad par ni ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug gi dus dngos gzhi dang po la sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bteg pa de nyid yin pas ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta dzaḥzhes pa'i rjes su/

spos rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad// ces sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing spyan drangs pa la/ rang gi g.yon du shaṃ las sogs nas mnyes par byas/ oṃ āḥpradzñān+ta kṛta sogs brjod cing*/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i skabs su sta gon gyi lha yang bstim pa'i dmigs pa byed pa yan gyi tshig 'don gzhan mi dgos gsung*/ gnyis pa nyer sgrub dang*/ gsum pa sgrub pa la mig gnyis kyi dbus su sogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin no// de nas ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon sogs nas bstod pa'i bar lha sta gon bzhin bya'o// nang mchod 'bul ba'i gong du bdud rtsi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul lo// bzlas pa'i tshe oṃ āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa nas kṛta hoḥzhes gtso bo la gang song ba'i grangs 'khor la de'i bcu cha bzlas pa byas nas/ mjug tu/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ rang nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol lam yol pas bar bcad de/ de'i phyi rol du phyogs skyong gi gtor ma gtong ba la/ sbyor ba stegs kyi steng du maṇ+ḍal la dbus su steng gi tshom bu gsum dang*/ phyogs mtshams su re re/ de'i shar gyi g.yon dang*/ nub byang gi g.yon dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi nub tu g.yas g.yon du re re bkod la/ de'i g.yas su chu gsum dang*/ g.yon du nyer spyod/ mdun du gtor ma nang mchod dang bcas pa bshams la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas mchod pa byin brlabs gong ltar dang*/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mgron bskyed pa ni/

rang skad cig gis 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis zhes pa nas/ shar du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ de'i g.yon phyogs su rdo rje sgyu ma sngon po zhes sogs nas/ de'i g.yon du sa'i lha mo ser mo rnam snang gi cod paṇa can zhes ming tsam brjod pas gsal gdab cing*/ thams cad kyang sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi shes rab ma la zhes pa nas mtshan dang dpe byad nye bar 'bar ba zhes pa'i bar bsdu na de ltar rung ngo*// rgyas par ni gtor chog nang bzhin bya'o// de la chu gsum nyer spyod rdo rje ma lnga/ gtor sngags lan gsum/ nang mchod/ rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥdus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi// sogs nas hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin dang*/ mjug tu dpal ldan bla ma sogs nas bsrung du gsol zhes brjod pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma ltar dang*/ de'i tshe sgrub grogs kyis mchod pa zhal zas nas mchod yon bar du rim pas gtor snod du bsdus la bzhag yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ slob dpon gyis mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥ

chos rnams thams cad rnam dag pas// sdig pa thams cad nges par sbyongs// rnam par rtog pa thams cad byabs/ sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐ zhes dang*/ de'i tshe slob mas zhabs bsil gtor snod la g.yas su bskor te lhag ma 'gro phyogs su bsgrengs la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twā ta hūm̐ muḥzhes pas phyogs mtshams su gshegs par bsam zhing*/ sgrub mchod rjes ma'i nyin ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod/ gong ltar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rang dang sgrub grogs kyi gnas gsum bsrungs la/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs zhes pa nas sa gtsang sar dor zhes pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin bya'o// de nas nang du log ste yig brgya brjod cing shong na dkyil 'khor la dngos su bskor ba gsum bya/ mi shong na 'dod snam gyi steng nas byas par bsams la dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas phyag dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra bai ga kra ma hoḥzhes dkyil 'khor bteg la/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog dbul/ sngags de nyid kyis me tog rang gi mgo bor bcings/ khro bo'i lta bas bltas la nub sgo nas g.yon brkyang gi stabs dang*/ lag pa hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya drag tu dkrol te/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra ud+gha ṭa sa ma ya prā be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas shar sgo dbye bar bsam/ de bzhin du byang nas lho dang*/ shar nas nub sgo dang*/ lho nas byang sgo dbye bar bsams la/ shar nas dkyil 'khor la phyag byas nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes brjod la rang gnas su 'dug go /slar yang gtso bo'i sngags kyis chu gsum dang*/ puṣ+pe nas shap+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ oṃ āḥhrīḥbum̐ ām̐ nas hūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul la/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su bcad gtubs su dkrol la/

hūm̐ hūm̐ 'khor ba 'don byed sku 'dzin pa// gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i sbyor bas mchod// 'jig rten dbang phyug khyod 'ba' zhig /te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐ te na te te hūm̐/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma la// lha dang mi yis 'dud pa'i mchog /sprul pa'i me tog sna tshogs dag /'jig rten dbang phyug khyod 'ba' zhig /te na sogs/ dngos po rnam grol rnam par bsnyen// gsang ba'i gsang ba 'dzin pa khyod// bdud rtsi mtha' med gsol ba khyod// khyod kyi dgongs pa sangs rgyas yin// te na sogs/ rtsom spangs sems can don mdzad pa// rgyu med gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo// te na sogs/ dung dang ku mu ta yi gzugs// rgya mtsho dwangs ma zla gzugs 'dra// te na sogs/ rol pa gnyis med rnal 'byor mdzad// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya 'dzin// te na sogs/ sgyu 'phrul lus kyis 'gro ba gzung*// rkyen gyis ma byas gzugs can yin// te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐ te na te te hūm̐/ zhes brjod par bya'o// dngos gzhi gnyis pa nas skabs 'dir bum pa sta gon ltar bsgrub/ gsum pa ni 'og nas 'byung ba ltar slob ma la dbang ji tsam bskur ba rang nyid bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs nas slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir bden pa'i stobs 'di brjod par bya ste/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// 'jig rten dbang phyug bdag grub mdzod// kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod// nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid bdag grub mdzod// shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog

/dbang phyug chen po rgyal mchog gi /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing*// sems can kun gyi snying la 'jug /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid// 'dod chags dam tshig mchog gyur pa// bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor yin// bden pa de yis mgon bdag la// khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor gyi// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod do// dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i brda sprod ni/ sta gon byas pa'i slob ma rnams gral la rim bzhin snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ chos gsan pa'i sems bskyed dang kun spyod rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par bshad pas gsal gdab par bskul nas/ 'dir 'khor bar sdug bsngal can gyi sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la gzhag pa'i slad du/ tshe 'di'i bya ba snying po med pa thams cad spangs te/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dpal gsang ba 'dus pa thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya dgos/ de'i ched du bden gnyis zung 'jug tu rtogs pa'i lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas/ bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa dbang gong ma gsum mtha' rten dang bcas pa blangs la nyams su blang bar bgyi snyam pa'i 'dun pa dung pa re bskyed mdzod/ de la sta gon du gnas pa yan chad legs par grub nas/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/

bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba bzhi las/ dang po la thig gis bri ba/ tshon gyis bri ba/ mtshan ma dgod pa/ rgyan dgram pa ste bzhi dang*/ sgrub cing mchod pa la/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi sgo nas bdag mdun tha mi dad pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub cing mchod nas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas bye ste/ phyi rol du phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs rnams gtor mas tshim par bya ba rnams dgos te kho bos sngon du legs par grub pa yin zhes brjod/ ras ris ltar na gong gi dngos gzhi'i cho ga la zhes pa'i rjes su ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi sgo nas zhes pa nas grub pa yin zhes pa'i bar gyis chog bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba la slob dpon rang la dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa med pa dang*/ slob ma'i rgyud smin pa'i bdag rkyen nus pa'i phyir/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang thams cad bdag 'jug gi tshul gyis len pa ste/ de dag kyang grub cing de'i rjes su phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir du dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs shing*/ de kho na nyid dang bden pa bsgrags pa dgos pa rnams grub par byas pa yin/ da khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhugs nas dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis las/ 'jug pa la/ maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab rgyun bshags bya// sdom gzung bgegs bsangs mig ras bcings// drin lan byas te me tog gtad// yon dbul nang sems gsang bar gdams// nang gzhug dam gzhag maṇ+ḍal gsol// ye shes dbab brtan kha dog dri// me tog dor phye dkyil 'khor bstan// zhes pa ltar las/

thog mar slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen sogs nas 'tshal zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyun bshags bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa brda sprod sta gon ltar byas te gang zhig thog med nas gnas par bgyi/ zhes rgyud dag par byas nas mdor na rigs lnga sogs nas 'das la 'god/ ces dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin par khas blangs nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin sogs nas kṛta hūm̐ zhes sta gon ltar bya'o// dbang bskur ba la dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas/ sngon chad bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor du sogs nas ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis mig ras bcings nas rigs nges par bya ba'i slad du/ sdug pa khyod su yin zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag ni skal ba bzang po lags// zhes lan btab nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha sogs nas sngar gyi sngags des me tog phreng ba gtad/ yon dbul ba ni/ khyed rnams kyi lus longs spyod la sogs pa thams cad slob dpon la dbul bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ yul mkhar khyim dang glang po rta// bran dang bran mo chung ma sdug /bu mo shin tu yid 'ong dang*// gang gi rang gi lus 'di yang*// deng nas brtsams te dbul bar bgyi// slob dpon du ni nyer gnas phyir// rdo rje chen po nyer gnas phyir// sems can thams cad bskyab don du// bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi// zhes yon phul nas/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba sogs nas snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs nas/ de'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhig gsal lam gyis byung bar mos te/

de gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa de snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ su ra ti sa shin tu dga' ba'i dam tshig nyid// ji ltar grub pa rdo rje bde// ma ya s+t+waṃ ho/ sid dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas brtan par byas/ de ltar sems bskyed pa de dang*/ gzhan yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun du spyod pa thams cad snod dang mi ldan pa'i mdun du smrar mi btub bo// zhes gsang bar gdams pa'am gsang ba bsgrags pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig dad pa dang mi ldan pa rnams la'ang ma yin no zhes gsang bar bsgrags nas/ nang 'jug gi slad du khyed rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs par mos nas/ dkyil 'khor phyogs la dbu dud pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta nas hoḥzhes khro bo bzhi'i sngags dang*/ kun tu nam mkha'i dpa' bo/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ nang gi 'jug pa la sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa bzhi'i dang po phan yon brjod pas dam la gzhag pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang dang gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya'i/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed cig dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ nyes dmigs brjod pas dam la gzhag pa ni/ snying gar rdo rjes gtugs la/

oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// gnyi ga brjod pas sam/ mna' chu sbyin pas dam la gzhag pa ni/ bdud rtsi lce la gzhag cing oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ bla ma'i bka' gnyan pas dam la gzhag pa ni/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba bsgo ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa ma byed cig mi bde ba ma spangs par khyod dus byas te dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re zhes pa rnams kyis dam la bzhag nas nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par gyur cig ces gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rnams lus tsog pu sogs nas khyed rnams 'od dpag tu med pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i rkang pa'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ gzhu'i dbyibs can mchog ma la ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su dzhaiṃ me'i rang bzhin/ sum mdor ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba/ snying gar lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa'i mtshams bzhir rdo rjes mtshan pa la hūm̐/ mgrin par bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas mtshan pa la ha/ spyi bor yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon zla gam la as mtshan pa rnams gsal btab nas/ slob dpon dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog ste rlung g.yos pas rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ las me 'bar/

sum mdo'i me dang gcig tu 'dres shing cher 'bar/ snying ga'i sa tshig mgrin pa'i chu khol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mnan cing rlangs pa ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kha ba babs pa ltar spyan drangs te/ khyed rnams kyi dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas thim par bsams te/ gu gul gyi dud pa dang rol mo'i sgra bya zhing*/ dril bu dkrol la/ ā be sha ya/ stam+bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃ zhes brjod de dbab/ de ltar ye shes babs pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas brtan par byas par mos/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ phebs pa'i rtags ni sku babs na sogs nas srel bar gyis shig dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i slad du/ mig mig ras dang bcas bzhin pas dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la bltas sogs kyis brtags nas/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin sogs nas snyam pa'i blos pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hos me tog dkyil 'khor la dor/ de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs la/ pra sems dpa' stobs ni chen po kye// 'di ni rang gis so sor bzung*/ ti gṛh+na swa mi maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la zhes me tog phog pa'i lha la bos nas/ des kyang me tog phreng ba slar byin par bsams la spyi bor bcings te me tog phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba'o// mig gi snang ba dri/ mig gnyis su oṃ 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas pa bsams la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// gdong ras bsal te he badz+ra pa sh+ya zhes pa ni kye rdo rje ltos shig ces bskul ba yin pas dkyil 'khor la gzigs shig ces bsgo/
