de yang 'di na bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor bzhugs te/ phyi rol na rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur me ri dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chos 'byung kha dog dkar po'i nang du tshud pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sogs nas/ bdun gyi gdan re re dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin/ brten pa lha ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gsum phyag drug pa sogs nas/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po sogs nas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o// zhes sgrub thabs ltar brjod pa'am/ mi nus na dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdog lta bu/ shar du rnam snang dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa sogs nas byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug ces ming tsam brjod/ gong ltar yang de ltar na lhag pa'i lha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mthong ngo snyam du mos pa mdzad/ de rnams kyis lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la/ rang don phun sum tshogs pa slob ma'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba gnyis la/ dang po la/ maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab// chu dang cod paṇa rdo rje dang*// dril bu dang ni ming dbang dang*// thugs gsung sku yi dam tshig rnams// so sor ma 'dres rim bzhin bskur// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab pa ni sngon 'gro yin/

dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa zhes sogs byang gzhi sbyong byed sbyang tshul sogs kyi rnam gzhag bla med spyi ltar brjod/ cho ga dngos la/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rten la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ba la/ thog mar mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ las bum gyi chu slob ma dang dbang rdzas la gtor te/ slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥbigh+nān gyis bsang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tas sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang*/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du khyed rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang*/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs nas/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta dzaḥzhes pa nas bigh+nān+ta kṛta hoḥkhyed rnams la thim/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta dzaḥnas hoḥ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la bstim pa ni yan lag dang po bsnyen pa'o// khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas lhar gsal ba'i mig tu sa'i snying po dkar po/ rna bar phyag rdor sngon po/ snar nam snying ser po/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po/ skra mtshams su sgrib sel ljang gu/ lte bar kun bzang dkar po zhes skye mched drug byin gyis brlabs pa ni yan lag gnyis pa nyer sgrub bo// thugs kar thugs rdo rje nag po/

mgrin par gsung rdo rje dmar po/ spyi bor sku rdo rje dkar po zhes gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa ni yan lag gsum pa sgrub pa'o// slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa bsdu rgyas spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa ni dbang rdzas kyi yan lag bzhin pa sgrub chen no// dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur bltas la/ khyed rnams la yan lag bzhi pa bsgrub pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig tu mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs te/ khyed rnams mi bskyod par gsal ba'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar mos/ rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// gsang ba gsum ni gnas las byung*// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par mos pa ni slob ma'i yan lag bzhi pa sgrub chen no// de ltar khyed rnams mi bskyod pa gdan gsum tshang ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rdo rje me tog ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par mos/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shap+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/

de ltar mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas mi bskyod pa'i sa bon nam bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no zhes brjod/ dbang lha spyan 'dren dor ba dang lha dang dbang rdzas go 'pho ba ma gtogs 'og ma rnams la'ang tshul des 'gre'o// rin chen 'byung ldan cod paṇa gyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bsang sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du gnyis ka'ang rin 'byung ser po/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dar dang sogs nas bzhugs pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka sogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ āḥya mān+ta nas hoḥkhyed rnams la thim/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta nas hoḥdabang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas lhar gsal ba'i mig tu sa snying dkar po sogs nas lte bar kun bzang dkar po/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje zhes pa nas spyi bor sku rdo rje dkar po slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa sogs nas dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ khyed rnams la yan lag bzhi pa bsgrub pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig tu rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin gyi cod paṇa gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs te/
khyed rnams rin chen 'byung ldan gsal ba'i spyi bor bcings te dbang bskur bar mos/ rdo rje chen po sogs nas/ sbyin par bya zhes dang*/ oṃ

rin chen cod paṇa dbang bskur ro/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes sogs nas/ de nyid brtan pa'i phyir bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur bar mos/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa sogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ de ltar khyed rnams rin chen 'byung ldan gdan gsum tshang ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la rdo rje me tog ma la sogs pas mchod par mos/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon nam bag chags rgyud la gzhag pa yin no// 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang gi slad du/ bsang sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs zhes pa nas gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med dmar po/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ dar dang sogs nas 'od dpag med kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥsogs nas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ yan lag bzhi pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas gsol/ skur byed rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun du rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long*// brtan byed chu dbang*/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa sogs nas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ de la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/

'od dpag med kyi sa bon nam bag chags rgyud la gzhag pa yin no// don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang gi slad du/ bsang sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te sogs nas gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa ljang gu/ ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dar sogs nas don yod grub pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥsogs nas don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ yan lag bzhi pa'i phyir/ de bzhin sogs nas gsol/ skur byed rnams kyis oṃ badz+ra rdo rje'i bdag khyod dbang bskur bgyi/ rdo rje'i dam tshig gnas khyod la'o/ a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes byin pa'i rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas pas lus kyi nang byang chub kyi sems kyis bum pa ltar gang bar mos/ brtan byed chu dbang*/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa sogs nas don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ de la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon nam bag chags rgyud la gzhag pa yin no// rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang gi slad du/ bsang sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du khyed rnams kyi gzugs kyi phung po rnam snang dkar po/ dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/

g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ mdzes pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes sgrub thabs bzhin rigs lnga char sogs la sbyar la/ bsdu na dar dang sogs nas bzhugs pa zhes gang mos brjod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sogs nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥsogs nas sku rdo rje dkar po/ 'dir dbang rdzas lhar bsgrub pa med pas khyed rnams la yan lag bzhi pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas gsol/ skur byed rnams kyis oṃ badz+ra rdor sems khyod la dbang bskur bgyi// rdo rje ming dbang bskur ro kye/ satwa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi badz+ra nā ma/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa a bhi ṣe ka ta/ brtan byed chu dbang*/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa sogs nas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shap+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon nam bag chags rgyud la gzhag pa yin no// dbang de rnams kyi don ni/ rang gi dngos kun gang gang snang*/ gtso de 'jig rten dbang phyug rang*// chos rnams rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i// sangs rgyas ye shes gang yin de'o// zhes gsungs te/ de'ang dngos po ste chos can gyi snang ba gang dang gang snang ba ni gtso bo ste/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha yin la/ lha de yang glo bur du byas pa ma yin gyi/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnyog pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ gdod ma nas lhar rnam par dag cing glo bur gyi dri ma rnams cho ga 'dis sel bar byed pas na/ da phyin chad tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog spangs nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su blta bar gyis shig ces pa'i tha tshig go

/de dag gis ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa lnga rig pa ye shes lngar gnas sgyur bar byed pas rig pa'i dbang ngam/ rig ma spyan la sogs pa'i thabs rig pa yab lnga'i las yin pas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya'o// de rnams kyis chos can gyi snang ba thams cad lhar byin gyis brlabs nas/ de dag gi chos nyid drug pa rdo rje sems dpar ngo sprad de sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob par byed pa/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du rdo rje gsor te/ bsang sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rang gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum sogs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥsogs nas sku rdo rje dkar po/ de la oṃ badz+rī bha wa sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de la rdo rje brtul zhugs dang rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig sbyin pa'i slad du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa sogs nas brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi slad du byin par mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// grub pa'i rdo rje'i dam tshig brtan// 'di ni khyod kyis gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes dbyings/ sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha/ ai ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes pas byin pa'i rdo rje de nyid snying gar gsor nas bzung ste/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtod mdzod/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i mchog

/ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ kye rdo rje 'di ni sogs nas nges don gyi rdo rje yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na rdo rje thugs kyi dbang thob/ mi rtog pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi thugs 'grub cing*/ dam tshig tu rdo rje sangs rgyas kyi thugs su mos pa mdzod/ des rdo rje brtul zhugs dang*/ thugs kyi dam tshig cig car du sbyin pa yin no// dril bu gsung gi dam tshig sbyin pa'i slad du/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa sogs nas byin par mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// shes rab sgra yi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces pas byin pa'i dril bu de 'khrol te dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan nas bzung ste dril bu'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtod mdzod// srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog tu byed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ kye dril bu 'di ni sogs nas nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na dril bu gsung gi dbang thob/ ngag bzlas pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gsung 'grub/ dam tshig tu dril bu sangs rgyas kyi gsung du mos pa mdzod/ phyag rgya chen po'i sku'i dam tshig gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku thams cad dang rtsa zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rang dang 'dra ba'i yum 'jig rten dbang phyug ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas pad+ma/ gsum pas ral gri/ g.yon gnyis pas rin po che/ gsum pas 'khor lo bsnams pa/ rin po che dang nor bu'i sogs nas bzhugs pa'i sku can du gyur par mos nas/

rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ste/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid brjod pa la thugs gtod mdzod/ gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i dam tshig gis// gsang sngags ma tshang med par bzlas// rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo de// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya// dka' thub sdom pa mi zad pa// bsten na mi snang mngon shes dang*// mkha' la rgyu dang lus ngag yid// las byung dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur// de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams// 'dod pa thams cad bsten pa yis// chos kyi yi ge mchog brnyes so// bde dang sdug bsngal de bdag min// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams bsten// ye shes don gnyer 'dod chags can// sbyor bas bsgoms na myur du 'grub// sku gsung thugs ni yang dag 'grub// gang gzhan dman par bshad pa ni// sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur ba// sku gsung thugs ni bsgoms pas so// de nyid kyis ni rdo rje gzung*// chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya// dam tshig gi ni phyag rgya cher// byin gyis brlabs la snying po bzlas// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ tha mal pa'i bde ba ni sogs nas 'di la gnas par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ de ltar na sku'i dbang thob/ lha bsgom pa la dbang zhing gzugs kyi sku 'grub/ dam tshig tu sku gzugs la sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des slob ma'i dbang grub nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la bzhi yod pa'i dang po la/ maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab dbang stegs gzhag /rigs lnga'i mdor bsdus chu dbang bskur// rgyas gdab rab gnas mchod pas mchod// rnam dag bstan nas rjes gnang sbyin// zhes pa ltar las/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas kyis// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba bzhin// bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor dbang stegs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dar gyis bkab pa'i steng du/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi skur gsal ba'i steng du bla re/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor du dung dang 'phan la sogs pas bskor ba'i bkur sti dang bcas te bzhugs par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs te/ skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bzhugs pa de rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dang rol mo'i sgra la sogs pa dang bcas te rig pa'i dbang lnga mdor bsdus te bskur dgos pa las/ thog mar nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba nas a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes dang*/ yang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin gyi cod paṇa gyi dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje chen po'i nas mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ dang*/ de bzhin du 'od dpag med sangs rgyas kun gyi nas khyod kyis long dang*/ don grub oṃ badz+ra a dhi nas sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dang*/ rnam snang oṃ badz+ra satwa nas ṣe ka ta zhes pa'i bar rnams la snga ma'i rigs 'gre'o// de ltar na rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas nyon mongs pa zhe sdang la sogs pa dag rnam shes la sogs pa'i phung po lnga gnas gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin mngon du byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/

slar yang brtan pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba thogs te chu'i dbang bskur bar mos/ rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba zhes pa nas a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ las kyi rdo rjes bum pa dang me tog bzung*/ slob dpon phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol bar mos/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis bkra shis brjod mthar zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag par byas/ dbang bskur gyi lha thams cad 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngar gyur nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bor brgyan par bsam/ de la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par mos/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā brjod cing me tog gtor/ de la mnga' dbul gyi tshul du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rdo rje me tog ma la sogs pas mchod pa rgyas pas mchod par mos/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid bstan te/ mi mnyam med pa zur bzhi pa// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas min mnyam nyid// lus tshor sems dang chos rnams kyi// gcig dang sna tshogs brjod bral nyid// de dran de la dad pa gang*// shar sgo byang chub phyir gdod do// de las byung dang 'byung 'gyur ba'i// phyin ci log spangs mi bskyed bya// ma skyes skyes pa'i yang dag kyang*// bskyed pa dang ni gnas bya ba// brtson 'grus rnam bzhi lho yi sgo// 'dun dang spro dang gnas dang blo// rdzu 'phrul rkang dang dran pa 'dir// nub kyi sgo ni yin par bshad// dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan// shes rab dbang stobs mnyam med de// ting nge 'dzin yang byang de ltar// dran dang dbang po sgo bzhi yin// dang po la sogs bsam gtan bzhi// rta babs bzhi ni byung ba yin// dpa' bar 'gro dang mkha' mdzod sogs// ting 'dzin kha khyer yin par bshad// lag na mchod thogs dbyen spyo rnams// tshig la sogs pa'i gzungs tshogs yin// gang phyir sna tshogs rgyan ldan pa// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o// gdul bya bskyod pa dam pa'i chos// yan lag dgu sgra kun grol ba// ba dan sna tshogs rlung gis bskyod// rtse mo dril btags sgra sgrogs yin// ye shes me long byang yan lag

/phyogs dus kun ni 'od rab gsal// drwa ba drwa phyed nyi zla dang*// rnga yab me long me tog phreng*// de yi 'khor lo sogs ka ba// rnam thar brgyad kyis sbyangs pa yin// de yi nang gi 'khor lo de// dkyil 'khor brgyad pa lta bu yin// phyogs kun dus gsum rdzogs sangs rgyas// rdo rje theg pa rab ston pas// kun nas yongs su zlum por ni// rdo rje thig gis bskor ba yin// ye shes kyis 'gro la zhen pas// tshon ni rdzogs sangs rgyas lnga yin// dbang po don sogs rnam dag pas// rang gi mtshan nyid dben pa nyid// shes rab ye shes bdud rtsi ni// rdo rje can sogs bum pa'ang de// tshogs rdzogs pa yi rgyu mthun pa// thugs rje rlan nyid bum pa gang*// dkyil 'khor gang du me tog spos// mar me che dang drir bshad pa// byang chub yan lag yid rab tshim// chos kyi snang ba grags bsdus yin// chos kyi zas ni lha bshos yin// ngo tsha khrel yod pa yi gos// glu gar snyan dang rol mo rnams// bde ba chen po rnams 'phel ba'o// grong khyer thar pa'i grong khyer bas// dkyil 'khor snying po bsdus pa yin// 'khor lo de nyid legs bstan nas// lha yi de nyid bstan par bya// dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan// rnam dag sgo srung mchog gi gzugs// sku sogs 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor sems// shes rab dag pa rab dri med// sbyin sogs drug po'i phyi rol dag /gzugs rdo rje la sogs rang bzhin// sa thabs la sogs mtshan med phyir// sbyin la sogs pa'i ngo bo yin// don dang sems can bdag kun rtog /'jug pa'i shes pa rnam dag pa// me long la sogs ye shes ni// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo yin// ma skyes ye shes sbyor ba yi// 'khor lo'i gtso bo lta bur snang*// gzugs sogs 'khrul pa legs dag pa// phung po skye mched khams rnams so// ser sna la sogs gnas gyur pa// pha rol phyin par shin tu gnas// rang gi mi mthun gnas gyur pa// stobs sogs tshang zhing dri ma med// rnam par mi rtog zab pa dang*// rgya che ba ni rang bzhin 'byung*// zab dang rgya che 'di dag nyid// shes rab thabs bdag nyid gang ste// so so rang rig chos yin phyir// dbye yod dbye med sogs mi gnas// de ltar spros par gyur pa ni// pha rol phyin sogs 'bras bur snang*// zhes pa'i don/

rten gzhal yas khang pa ni lam byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa yin la/ brten pa lha rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la sogs pa rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin no zhes rnam dag bstan nas/ rnam dag rtogs pa'i slob ma la rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ bla ma dag skabs 'dir kye rdo rje ltar rjes gnang rgyas par mdzad pa bris snang ba ni bzhi brgya lnga bcu par mi 'byung yang*/ de'i 'grel par shān+ti pas lha mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rjes gnang rnams kye'i rdo rje ji lta ba bzhin bris snang bas spros pa la dga' na bya zhing*/ bsdu na/ sman zhabs kyis/ de bzhin slob ma dbang bskur dang*// dngos grub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// sgrub pa'i thabs ni rab brtan pas// gang zag gnyis su shes par bya// gzugs brnyan glegs bam la sogs pa// yod na khyod kyis rab gnas mdzod// de ni ji srid bar du ni// sems can don du 'gyur bas so// zhes gsungs pa'i don slob dpon gyi las su bya ba dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa la sogs pas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa gyis shig ces pa'i tha tshig go /de ltar na rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag par byas shing bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob par byas pa yin no// gnyis pa gsang dbang la/ maṇ+ḍal gsol btab gdong bcings nas// dmigs pa rdzas byin mig ras bsal// zhes pa ltar gsang dbang gi yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsang ba'i dbang gi rten phyag rgya gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa/ yon tan du ma dang ldan pa rnal 'byor la goms shing dam tshig sdom pa la shin tu gnas pa zhig 'jig rten dbang phyug longs sku'i rang bzhin can la phul bar mos shing gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas kyis la sogs pas lan gsum/ sngon chad kun rdzob sogs nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing gdong g.yogs bcings te/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bla ma 'jig rten dbang phyug yab yum zag pa med pa'i bde ba la snyoms par zhugs/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi sku rnams spyan drangs nas yab yum gyi zhal du thim/ thugs kar zhu nas gsang ba'i mthar byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa de nyid slob dpon gyi mthe bong dang srin lag gis blangs te/ khyed rnams blo brtan pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i lce thog tu gzhag ste gsang ba'i dbang bskur bar mos/ slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing sbyin zhes byin pa'i bdud rtsi de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos te/ 'thungs pas bde ba sna tshogs kyis lus gang bar mos shing*/ kye ma shin tu bde chen zhes gsungs shig de ltar myangs pas mgrin pa na gzhir gnas pa'i ya ra la wa sogs nas 'bru gsum gsung zhing mig ras 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang gis ngag gi dri ma dag rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ sgyu lus bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par byed pa yin no// gsum pa shes rab ye shes la/ dang po gsum 'dra shes rab gtad// 'du shes dga' bzhi mig ras bsal// zhes pa ltar las/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab sngar bzhin/ sngon chad yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du gdong bcings la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas mtshan nyid mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i rig ma yid du 'ong ba/ lang tsho dar la bab pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig sprul te khyed rnams la gtad par mos/ gzugs 'di shin tu yid 'ong ste// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtag

/'khor lo rim gyis rab sbyor bas// bde ba dam pa yang dag sbyor// zhes pas byin nas/ khyed rnams 'jig rten dbang phyug dang rig ma 'jig rten dbang phyug mar gsal ba sprul sku lam du byed pa lha'i 'du shes/ yum gyi spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ yig dkar po zhes pa nas ze'u 'bru'i bug par phaṭa ser pos bkag pa zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod/ mkha' gsang sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa longs sku lam du byed pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes sum ldan sngon du 'gro bas phyag rgya'i gzugs la blta ba dang*/ sgra la nyan pa dang*/ dri la snom pa dang*/ ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi myang ba dang*/ phan tshun 'khyud pa dang tsum+ba dga' ba/ rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyar ba mchog dga'/ bsrub pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ byang chub kyi sems gsang ba'i gnas nas ma 'phos pa'i dus su lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba bde ba la mi rtog pa'i ngang du skyongs shig ces pa tsam mam/ yang na de ni phyi go rim la ltos pa'i dga' ba yin/ nang gnas la ltos pa'i dga' ba ni sogs nas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes zhes bya ba yin te/ rdo rje skyil krung nyid dang sems// nor ldan khongs su rtogs par lta// dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dag /rab gsang shes rab mchog gis ni// dbang bskur de nyid yang dag bshad// de yas babs kyi dga' ba yin// mas brtan gyi dga' ba'i slad du byang chub kyi sems sogs nas de thams cad la mi rtog pas khyab ste/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum ngo bo stong pa nyid du ro gcig pa'i ngang du mnyam par zhog cig ces kye rdor ltar brjod do// de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis mig ras bkrol bar zhu/

de ltar na yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang gsum pas gtso cher sems kyi dri ma sbyangs shing gzhan lus phyag rgya bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob par byed pa yin no// bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa la/ dang po gsum 'dra dmigs pa bstan// gdong bsal dam tshig bshad lung bstan// dbugs dbyung gzings bstod rjes gsum mo// zhes pa ltar las/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sngon chad don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing gdong g.yogs bcings/ de'ang dbang bzhi pa gang la bstan pa'i yul ni/ saṃ pu ṭa las sogs nas slob ma zhig sbyin par bya ste/ de nyid tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad pa ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med par mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes gsungs te/ rgyud sde rnams las/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no// zhes pa mtshon bya mtshon byed du gsungs pa'i don/ mtshon bya don gyi dbang bzhi pa yang sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin la/ de'i mtshan nyid phyi rol pas brtags pa'i bdag gi dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing*/ nyan thos sde gnyis kyis brtags pa'i phung khams skye mched kyi chos dang gzung 'dzin gnyis rnam par spangs la/ rnam rig pas brtags pa'i gnyis med kyi shes pa tsam gyi rtog pa dang yang bral ba'i rang sems thabs kyi cha gsal la/ ma 'gags pa de nyid skye 'gags thams cad dang bral ba/ mtha' bzhi char gyi spros pas stong pa'i stong nyid yin la de nyid/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med// snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi chad dang 'gog pa med// yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas 'di nyid ni// bdag 'dod tshad mas yongs bsgos blo can rnams kyang 'dod// ces gsungs pa ltar yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas yin no// de nyid dbang gsum pa'i ye shes 'dis mtshon nus pa yin no zhes ngo sprod pa ni tshig gi bzhi pa ste/

ji ltar mtshon na dbang gsum pa'i dus su lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa gsal la ma 'gags pa/ de'i sems rgyud 'dzag med kyi bde bas gang ba/ bde ba'i ngo bo la bltas pa na phyi rol pa'i bdag nas rnam rig pa'i gnyis med kyi shes pa'i bar gyi rnam par rtog pa gang yang ma grub pa'i nam mkha' lta bu yin pa/ de yang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad pa yin pas/ des mtshon nus pas na de'i ngang la mnyam par zhog cig ye shes de nyid las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mthar phyin te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yan lag bdun ldan mngon du gyis shig ces brjod pa ni lam gyi bzhi pa'o zhes pa'i don nyams su len par byed pa la/ lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sogs nas nam mkha' dang nam mkha' ro gcig pa ltar sems dang bde stong ro gcig pa'i mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de dbang bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhe gsung zhing mig ras 'grol ba zhu/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob par byed pa yin no// de nas dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i dam tshig bsrung bar gdams pa 'di la gsan pas khyab ste/ dbang bskur 'di ni ji lta bar// byang chub spyod gzhan de bzhin du// dge ba'i tshul ni gzhan gsungs pas// sangs rgyas kun sogs thob mi 'gyur// dam tshig rtag tu bsrung ba dang*// rtag tu sdom pa bskyang bar bya// bcu phyed sgron ma mi 'chi spyad// dam tshig gzhan yang bsrung ba ni// dkon mchog gnod gzhom bud med ni// mchog myang log pa'i lam ma yin// 'di dag cho ga bzhin du srungs// rnal 'byor rgyud du gang bshad pa'o// zhes gsungs te de'i don ni/

rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gzhi ma rtsa ba dang yan lag bza' bsrung dang mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig rnams la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du gyis shig ces pa'i tha tshig go /de ltar dbang bzhi thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bskyangs pas de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa ni/ lung phal cher sprul sku rab tu byung bas ston par srid pas skabs 'dir slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal du 'phos nas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis chos gos snying gar bzung zhing g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ rang rang gi gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur ro zhes slob dpon dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu lung bstan par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ngas khyod 'di ltar lung bstan te// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa'i mtha' ni grub pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro nyid las bton// kye de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba sid+dhi bhur+bhu wa swaḥ 'di yis dbang bskur gyur pa yi// sngags pa 'gro ba kun gyi bdag /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu// bde gshegs kyis kyang lung bstan mdzad// ces pa ste/ de yang lam gyi dus su sems can sna tshogs kyi don byed cing*/ thun bzhir ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi sbyor bas thun mong gi dngos grub mi snang ba dang*/ mngon shes dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'chang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no zhes lung bstan pas de ltar du 'gyur nges snyam pa'i dga' ba skyed mdzod/ de nas dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ gzengs bstod pa ni/ mchog gsang dkyil mchog dam pa 'di// mthong ba dang ni zhugs gyur pa// sdig pa kun las nges grol bar// khyod rnams 'di nyid legs par gnas// bde chen thig pa 'di las ni// slar khyod 'chi ba yod min te// mi tshugs pa dang mi chod pa// cis kyang mi 'jig dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir// ston pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin// dam tshig sdom pa 'grub pa 'di// rtag tu khyod kyis bsrung bar bya// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// dam pa rtag pa'i bka' yin no// gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni// sangs rgyas kun sogs dogs med pa'i// byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya// phyag na rdo rje gang yin pa'o// dam pa'i chos ni mi spong zhing*// nam yang dor bar mi bya'o// mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yi// tshul chen bsten par mi bya'o// bdag nyid yongs su spangs nas su// dka' thub kyis ni ma gdungs shig

/ci bde bar ni bde bas gzung*// 'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams// nam yang yongs su mi gtong zhing*// slob dpon smad par mi bya ste// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra// sangs rgyas kun mtshungs bla ma yi// slob dpon la ni gang smod pa// des ni sangs rgyas kun smad pas// rtag tu duḥkha thob 'gyur te// rims dang dug dang dbyig dug nad// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang*// gdon dang log 'dren gtum po yis// bsad nas sems dmyal ltung bar 'gyur// de bas nan tan thams cad kyis// rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che// dge ba rab tu mi spyoms pa// nam yang smad par mi bya'o// bla ma la ni gus bcas yon// rjes mthun khyod kyis sbyin par bya// des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams// phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// rtag tu rang gis dam tshig bsrung*// rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod// rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra// de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la// rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur// de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te// tshogs pas dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur// gang phyir 'di ni legs gnas pas// deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas// dam tshig lha rnams kun mnyam par// deng khyod 'gyur bar the tshom med// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pas// kun gyis deng khyod dbang bskur bas// khams gsum gyi ni rgyal po che// rgyal po'i bdag por bstan pa yin// de ni bdud las rnam rgyal te// grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs// khyed rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas nyid// de nyid thob par the tshom med// de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis// rang gis dam tshig mi zad bde bskyed bstan par gyis// deng ni 'gro las myur bde rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// rab tu mnyam zhing rtag pa nyid du rtogs par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/

snying po bde ba chen po len cing 'dzin par byed pa mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ khyed rnams cho ga'i sgo nas btsud cing mthong zhes sogs nas 'gyur ba yin no zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de ltar dbang bskur ba 'khor dang bcas pa legs par grub pas/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig thams cad la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa'i// gsung ni de bzhin bdag bgyid do// zhes dang dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gzhan yang lus longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po rnams kyang bla ma la phul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// zhes sogs brjod/ de ltar na 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyis legs par bkral ba'i gsang ba 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lha bcu dgu'i rdul tshon nam ras bris gang yin gyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba/ rgyud gzhung dri ma med pa las 'ongs pa'i lag len rnam par dag pa la brten nas dbang bskur ba legs par gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen mdzad pa zhu zhes brjod do// dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngos nas slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa mjug gi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos nas/ slob dpon gyis bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ de nyid lnga pa/ dngos grub blang ba/ lhag chad kha bskang ba/ bzod par gsol ba rnams sta gon gyi rjes chog ltar byas nas/ ras bris kyi phyogs yin na thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

khyad par du yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor ro// rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na gshegs gsol gyi nyin ma gtogs pa'i nyin snga ma rnams la/ gong gi khyad par du yang zhes pa'i rjes su/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du zhes sogs brjod la/ rten med pa rnams la oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs gang mos bya'o zhes gong ltar brjod do// rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi nyin rjes chog gi dus nas bum pa gnyis khyams kyi steng du shar drang por rnam rgyal g.yas dang*/ las bum de'i g.yon du mchu shar du bstan la gzhag go /cho ga gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ bzod gsol kyi rjes su slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar du 'grengs te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ ā kā ro sogs nas hūm̐ muḥrdul tshon gyi ye shes pa dang*/ bum nang gi ye shes pa dang*/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bsrungs la/ rol mo dang bcas pas oṃ a kā ro sogs brjod cing de kho na nyid dran pas rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang po bshig de nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas ci bde bar gshegs su gsol la/ mtshan ma'i rdul tshon rang gi spyi bor gzhag cing rdul tshon 'dod pa yod na sbyin no// gzhan rnams mtha' nas rim par bsdus te/

za ma tog la sogs par blugs la bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rgyas par brjod do// smras pa/ mtha' klas bde gshegs thugs rjes zlos pa'i gar// gzhi lam 'bras bu rnam dag dkyil 'khor gyi// 'khor lo'i yon tan bkod par shar ba'i grong*// skal ldan gzhug cing smin par byed pa'i tshul// gsang chen spyi 'gros bde ba'i lam du zhugs// khyad par ma 'dres shing rta'i 'khrul 'khor brten// ma lus rgyal bas rab gshegs grong khyer du// 'jug pa'i sgo 'di kun nas gsal bar phye// sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang a ti sha'i// legs gsungs ji bzhin rnam gzigs dkyus ring spyan// 'dzums pa mi mnga' ngor chen yab sras zung*// bzhed don 'grol ba'i tshul la spobs pa skyes// gzu lums khyab 'jug rkang pa'i dri ma med// lugs ngan drang srong dmod pas ma bcings par// yid ches cho ga'i skal ldan shing rta 'dis// glo bur dri ma mtha' dag sreg cing sbyong*// dkar 'dzum chu shel dbang po'i bsil zer gyi// lag pa brgya phrag brkyangs nas sa mos kha// 'byed pa gzhan gyis ma phye chos tshul 'di'i// gsal byed bdag cag 'os par ston pa mtshon// dge bas stobs cu mnga' bas blangs pa'i glur// nga yi chos tshul kun dga'i ro ldan de// snang byed bzang po gcig na 'di'o zhes// bsngags pa de bstan rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /gna' dus rnam par 'dren pas ma bsgral ba'i// ji snyed sems can rdo rje'i theg par brten// gnam 'phyo'i pho brang che las don mthun tshogs// ded dpon gyis bzhin 'don pa bdag gyur cig /ces dpal gsang ba 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor du slob ma smin par byed pa'i cho ga skal ldan shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa'i snang byed dam pa skyor mda' chos rje bsod nams dbang phyug pa'i gsung bskul sā la'i nags kyi dri khyer dal bus snying la sim par brten/

'di'i rgya gzhung rnams dang*/ kun mkhyen go rams pas mdzad pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang*/ de dang spyan ras gzigs kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyi tho yig gzhir bzung*/ gzhan yang bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i lhan thabs sogs la legs par gtugs te mtshams sbyor dbri bskyed gang 'os dang bcas shin tu gsal bar bsdebs pa 'di ni/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i lugs mchog dri ma med pa'i rjes su slob pa'i 'dun pa can ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde'am tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
